title: CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. translated_title: CUSP：面向多智能体多模态推理的可分解集体不确定性
translated_abstract: 聚合异构视觉语言模型（VLMs）可以提升多模态推理能力，但无论是单个模型的置信度还是聚合答案的置信度，都无法衡量系统层面的可靠性。我们提出了CUSP（通过语义意见池化实现的集体不确定性），这是一个无需训练的不确定性量化框架，它将多个VLM的响应映射到共享的语义响应空间，将其池化为一个池化语义意见，并报告两个互补的系统级信号：集体不确定性，即池化意见的离散程度；以及Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），即模型级意见之间的冲突程度。在该池化语义意见中，未归一化的集体熵可以精确分解为各个模型个体语义熵的均值与JSD之和，从而将总离散度与模型间冲突分离开来。CUSP既不需要token logits也不需要校准标签，因此适用于开源权重和商业模型（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的CUSP框架，通过语义意见池化量化多智能体多模态推理的系统级不确定性，并能将集体熵精确分解为模型个体语义熵均值与模型间冲突（JSD）两个可解释的信号。
en_tdlr: CUSP is a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that measures system-level reliability in multi-agent multimodal reasoning by pooling VLM responses in a shared semantic space, with collective entropy exactly decomposing into mean individual semantic entropy and inter-model conflict (JSD).
